learning.why: Teacher ne baar baar pucha, aur maine barf ke example se confirm kiya ki wapas aana physical change pehchaan ne ka tarika hai.

end.summary:
Discussed physical and chemical changes using roti, ghee, ice, burning leaves, and sugar dissolving.
Ananya identified roti baking as a chemical change because it cannot return to dough.
Ananya identified melted ghee and freezing water as physical changes because they can return to their original state.
Teach-back was not passed; the physical-change definition and examples were not stated independently as one complete response.
end.parentNote: Asha practised sorting changes by checking whether a new substance forms and whether the original material can return. Ananya gave relevant examples: baking roti as chemical, and melting/freezing ghee or water as physical; the roti mix-up was corrected later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, ask them to classify three examples and explain whether the original substance can be recovered.
